build_text_classification_model: build a TextClassificationModel with a SentEncoder and multi-layer classifier for text classification
run_text_classification_task: run a TextClassificationTask to train a model using cross entropy loss and batch forward passes
evaluate_text_classification: evaluate the TextClassificationTask model on a data iterator and report accuracy and loss stats
review_batch_forward: review the batch_forward method to compute loss and track correct predictions per batch
refactor_classifier_head: refactor the TextClassificationModel classifier head to adjust fc_dim or dropout for better performance
